name: When should I consider changing my kitchen's layout?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider changing my kitchen's layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider changing your kitchen's layout if your current space feels cramped, inefficient, or no longer meets your household's needs. Common reasons include poor workflow between key appliances (sink, stove, refrigerator), insufficient storage, a desire for an open-concept living area, or accommodating accessibility needs. If your kitchen's design hinders daily tasks, lacks adequate counter space, or doesn't support entertaining, a layout update can significantly enhance both its function and enjoyment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a layout change if your kitchen is cramped, inefficient, lacks storage, or no longer suits your lifestyle. Poor workflow or a desire for open concept are common triggers.
